claims.description: Adding, removing, or editing style elements invalidates cached layout snapshots.

notes.text: Package-contract tests verify snapshot invalidation when `style` elements are added, removed, or edited.

claims.description: Inserting, changing, or deleting CSSOM rules invalidates cached layout snapshots.

notes.text: The engine fingerprints live style-element CSSOM state before cached snapshot reads because CSSOM rule mutations do not emit `MutationObserver` records.
